environment: macOS (Darwin 25.6), Python 3.14.7, Node 24.19.0; local CLI only; testkit cli-runner and attack-corpus (plantDecoy) from skills/sdlc/test/testkit at 4434d71; worktree of sdlc/S-001 at 4434d71
threatModel: The spec states no threat model. Trusted: the files inside the skill directory and the Python interpreter. Untrusted: the cwd, PYTHONPATH and the path (symlink, relative path) through which a caller starts or loads a script. Attacks that need a write into the skill directory or control of the caller's own process are out of scope.
charters: Explore the branches import in next-action.py, state-write.py and janitor.py with decoy modules in the cwd, on PYTHONPATH and beside symlinks, to find a start path where a module other than skills/sdlc/branches.py binds, which breaks R-098 ('The branches import resolves through the script directory on sys.path').

cases.title: A decoy branches.py in the cwd or on PYTHONPATH never wins
cases.given: A decoy branches.py (exits 97) in the cwd and one on PYTHONPATH; a shadow decoy on PYTHONPATH with PYTHONSAFEPATH=1.
cases.when: Run each of next-action.py, state-write.py and janitor.py with --help by absolute path, by a relative path, and with python3 -I.
cases.then: Exit 0, no traceback, and no decoy import recorded.
cases.expected: Exit 0, no traceback, and no decoy import recorded.
cases.actual: All 12 runs exit 0. No decoy marker file exists.
cases.specSource: R-098 quote ('insert the script directory into sys.path and import it') and acceptance ('The branches import resolves through the script directory on sys.path')

seeds.title: An in-process caller with a cached branches module binds it, not the skill's module
seeds.detail: When a process already holds sys.modules['branches'], a script loaded through importlib binds that cached module and ignores the sys.path line (A-31). A test harness that imports a fixture or an older branches.py and then loads next-action.py in the same process tests the wrong module. Callers in the repo load each script in a new process, so nothing breaks today. Keep that rule for later probes.
